scenarios.title: Choked Estuary: revealing an Island from your hand, it enters untapped
instructions: Play Choked Estuary and reveal the Island in your hand.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Choked Estuary is untapped, and the Island stays in your hand.

scenarios.title: Choked Estuary: with no Island or Swamp in hand it enters tapped
instructions: Play Choked Estuary holding only a Forest.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Choked Estuary is tapped; nothing was revealed.
